items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Raymond Burke, you know. [INTERVIEWEE] Well, like I'm saying about George, boy, he always plays something different.

ctx.x: Pico was really saying on high society and them numbers like that, but not get off. He could play them better than anybody. But not get off, I don't know. I don't think he... Not now.

He plays any real variations, you know, now. No. It's the same thing night after night, you know. But he doesn't make up anything as he goes along. Oh no, he don't make up anything, no. Somebody like Melee Bonds, you get the feeling he plays it different every time. Raymond Burke, you know.
Well, like I'm saying about George, boy, he always plays something different.
